name: What is the typical process for a custom bathroom design and remodel project with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a custom bathroom design and remodel project with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our integrated design-build process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and specific needs for a luxury bathroom. We then move through detailed design planning, often including CAD-supported layouts and material selections, followed by permit coordination. Construction proceeds with our skilled craftsmen, culminating in a final walkthrough to ensure every detail meets our high standards. This managed process ensures a single point of coordination from concept to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves an initial consultation, detailed design planning, permit coordination, construction by skilled craftsmen, and a final walkthrough, all managed under one team.
